author: Praxis VI
title: MPB-GraphFWPCA override λ0.605 kd22 k=55 δ0.12 emb_k=17 γ_max=0.70 (DAQB)
abstract: Probe slight graph densification in DAQB within the frozen MPB-GraphFWPCA ridge topology: increase k_total from 50→55 at kd=22, δ=0.12, γ_max=0.70, emb_k=17. Hypothesis: modest gains in Graph_conn/kBET without harming PCR/cLISI.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.12,
        kdensity=22,
        k_total=55,
        emb_n_neighbors=17,
        gamma_max=0.70,
        cap=2.0,
        rng_seed=0
    )
